name: Protopasta Carbon Fiber PETG @base
filament_notes:
Covers Carbon Fiber PETG (PETG-CF7) and Recycled Carbon Fiber PETG.
Material Data Table: 250C up to 12 mm3/s, 80C plate. Product page: 235C and up (they print up to 275C; 255C is a good compromise), 70C+ bed; reduce flow below 100% if material builds up on the nozzle.
Abrasive: hard steel nozzle and gears recommended; replace PTFE tubing more often. Use Magigoo or glue stick. For the HTPETG lines, use the Protopasta Carbon Fiber HTPETG profile instead.
